name: BYD Company Limited
blurb: BYD Company Limited is a Shenzhen-based conglomerate founded in 1994 that operates across two primary segments: new energy vehicles (NEVs) and related products, and mobile handset components and assembly services. It is one of the world's largest manufacturers of electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles, selling across China, Europe, Southeast Asia, and other international markets. BYD also remains a major supplier of lithium-ion batteries to the consumer electronics industry, with a global workforce of approximately 869,600 employees and a Hong Kong-listed market capitalization near HKD 976 billion.
recent: BYD reported earnings on April 28, 2026, posting trailing-twelve-month revenue of approximately HKD 891–902 billion and net income of HKD 30.98 billion (EPS: HKD 3.40), reflecting notable year-over-year pressure on margins. The stock has declined roughly 25.6% over the past year, trading at HKD 98.15 as of May 14, 2026 — well below its 52-week high of HKD 159.27 reached in May 2025 and hovering above the 52-week low of HKD 88.50 set in February 2026. Forward PE of approximately 19x suggests analysts expect earnings recovery, though near-term sentiment remains cautious amid global EV pricing competition.
